stages.title: Whole operation protocol: full-set fresh, late child, 1:1 release
notes: signal preflights the complete set then the target; late/duplicate/foreign/unknown refuse; product assertions precede the release decision.

stages.title: Full-report scope, resources and business semantics
notes: operation contradictions, pending pre-stop question, effect/question/answer rows, registry, artifact ids and sameProject scoped 403 are rejected.

stages.title: Two original projects installed daily journey
notes: composite stale candidate refused; accept readiness verification-based; reopen compares ids and every byte; original-project applicability remains NOT_REACHED.

stages.title: Locked outer product with model settings boundary
notes: W33 outer phases plus instance reuse and invalid-permission policy; successor model-save surface HELD until a D-frozen package exists.

stages.title: Growing non-empty business backup and authorized recovery
notes: all artifact bytes, both Works, pre-stop question, effect rows, registry, auth policy and no-provider read-back.

stages.title: Non-empty upgrade, post-write and independent rollback
notes: E own W32→W33 managed upgrade with binary-only rollback; D's new raw retry is recorded separately from the preserved BLOCKED history.

stages.title: Colleague roots and multi-instance operation
notes: two explicit roots on one install, distinct identities, independent stop, doctor without secret echo; same machine/user only.

stages.title: Original Work recovery consumer
notes: NOT_REACHED with exact owner inputs; callbacks/slots/receipt-only rows are not substitutes.

stages.title: Layered tiers and complete handoff
notes: wave35-status separates legacy R1 and the W33 subset and keeps the pilot/native/value BLOCKED.

C/main: publish automatic proposal/context confirmation, the context-use send path (explicit selection, revalidation, same-transaction binding/receipt, no auto-resend, source audit) and recovery activation; E then converts E5-CONTEXT-USE and E5-RECOVERY-INTERRUPTION from NOT_TESTED.
D: keep the target immutable; a new target needs its own explicit identity (tar/sha/source/build/schema) and a fresh E4 run, not a mapping from build f2390ffd.
B: hand off native evidence bound to commit/attempt/command with executed=true and model-task counts; only a separately granted budget lets E re-run native.
Main: treat controlled-product-workflow PASS as workflow evidence only; local-alpha and full-product remain non-zero until installation and native evidence exist.
